text.p: Following is a summary of major Shanghai political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Shanghai and Shenzhen stock markets rose slightly on Tuesday.
- Three companies will list domestic A shares in Shanghai and Shenzhen on Wednesday.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Stock markets in Shanghai and Shenzhen expected to have a technical correction in the short term.
- Shanghai plans to build 12 million square metres of residential housing in 1997.
- Property market in the Pudong New Area offers great opportunity in 1997 partly due to the move of financial markets to the area.
